themes.note: A theme is a named palette with a scheme (light or dark). Every themed token keeps a light and a dark base value. A theme either sits on one of those base columns (base) or extends another theme (extends), and lists in overrides only the tokens whose values differ. A token resolves to the nearest override on the way down the extends chain, then to the base column the chain ends on. Themes of the same scheme are interchangeable: anything that branches on light or dark reads the scheme, never the theme name.

color.note: Neutral first. Ink on warm off-white, one accent (Infisical yellow #e3f047, the same in both themes), status colors that always travel with a word or icon. The app is a sidebar beside an inset, both light in light and both dark in dark. Dark mirrors light: ink becomes bone, the accent takes over the on switch and the mark, and selection stays neutral.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Near-black ground. The dark-theme sidebar sits on it (through sidebar); in light the sidebar is light and nothing in the app shell uses frame. It never wraps the inset. Never put text on it except inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: frame-soft
tokens.usage: Warm ground for embedded views and docs that want a frame around their content. In dark it matches frame.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The main panel and every inset card and input. Menus, popovers and dialogs float on pop. The default ground for text. A step above inset in both themes, so cards read on the page without a bright border.

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: Ground of everything that floats above the page: menus, listboxes, popovers, hover cards, dialogs, sheets. Equal to surface, as in the v4 reference: a panel separates from the page through pop-line and shadow-pop, never through a brighter fill. Always with pop-line and shadow-pop.

tokens.name: pop-line
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of a pop panel, drawn as a ring inside its shadow. Uses line-soft, the default outward-facing border, and the shadow carries the separation from the page.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: The app's page ground beside the sidebar, behind cards, tables and lists. Equal to surface in light, as in the v4 reference, and a step below it in dark (1.04:1), so a card separates from the page through its line-soft edge and frame rather than a ground step. Pads space-40 (bottom space-48).

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Ground of the app sidebar. tint in light (1.1:1 against the inset, so it needs its line-soft edge) and frame in dark. Text on it uses ink, text2 and muted: muted is 6.4:1 in light and 9.6:1 in dark. The current page is sidebar-current with ink text; counts are accent Counts, and a rail dot, which has no number, is accent-fg.

tokens.name: sidebar-current
tokens.usage: The current page in the sidebar, and a rail group that holds it: mix-ink at current-mix mixed opaquely into the sidebar (5.5% in light, 10% in dark), a small step past the shared hover overlay at hover-mix, so it follows every theme's sidebar with no per-theme value. Neutral, like every selection; in the sidebar only counts take the accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-hover
tokens.usage: The sidebar's hover highlight, the block that follows the pointer between rows. It matches sidebar-current unless a theme quiets it: Dark mixes current-mix into frame rather than its lifted sidebar, so hovering a row is a softer step than the current page.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet footers. A step off surface so the action bar reads as a shelf.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Borderless shells around bordered inset surfaces (cards, tables, lists), table headers, segmented tracks, disabled and read-only fields, the hover ground of striped table rows, and the light sidebar (through sidebar). In dark it is lifted so a borderless shell still reads against surface (1.11:1).

tokens.name: row-done
tokens.usage: Resolved list items that stay in place so nothing jumps.

tokens.name: row-done-card
tokens.usage: Resolved rows in a segmented List: half the tint card fill, so a resolved card stays in place and keeps its edge on the page in both themes, where row-done would vanish in dark.

tokens.name: row-done-divided
tokens.usage: Resolved rows in a divided List, which sit on the page with no container: translucent ink over whatever ground is behind (1.09:1 on the light page, 1.11:1 on the dark one), a clear step where row-done would vanish in dark and still quieter than hover (1.14:1 light, 1.33:1 dark).

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: Selection in connected rows: a list's current and checked rows, selected table and tree rows, DataGrid ranges, the pressed toggle Button. On rows it is the whole signal, with the row text one step up (text2 to ink, muted to text2); no edge bar. Neutral in both themes, never tinted: in dark it is 1.25:1 on surface and a step above tint (1.13:1), the same step as before.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: The default border: the outward-facing edge of inset surfaces, cards, plain lists, tables, popovers, dialogs and bordered controls that use a line token, the app shell chrome (the AppInset island border, the narrow TopBar rule, the sidebar edge, corner and section separators), and every divider that touches one of those edges, such as row hairlines, table cell dividers and dialog head and footer rules. Frames have no border; only the inset surface inside them carries line-soft. Also skeleton blocks, progress tracks and soft badges.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Reserved for a standalone rule that touches no other border: a section rule, the band's divider marks (through crumb-divider), a lone hr, a tree guide, the tab track, chart axes and grid lines. One step stronger than line-soft, so a free-standing line still reads without an edge to lean on. Never the edge of a surface or a divider that meets one; those are line-soft.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons. Source pair: 2.1:1 on surface in light and 1.6:1 in dark, below the 3:1 floor for control borders. Kept exact; focus turns the border ink with a 3px nudge outline. An invalid field rests on bad-control and turns bad with the 3px bad outline while focused.

tokens.name: crumb-divider
tokens.usage: The vertical divider between breadcrumb crumbs, in the TopBar and in page and folder trails. line, the standalone-rule tint: each divider is a lone mark that touches no other border, one step stronger than the line-soft shell chrome around it. Decorative: it never carries meaning.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text only; breadcrumb dividers use crumb-divider. 3.0:1 on surface in light (6.0:1 in dark): never for text people must read.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, placeholders, eyebrows and captions. 7.1:1 on surface, 6.4:1 on tint in light; 8.7:1 and 7.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: text2
tokens.usage: Body copy that sits one step below ink: descriptions in alerts, table cells, ghost button labels. 12.5:1 on surface in light, 13.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, tint, paper and select (at least 17:1 in light, 13:1 in dark). Also the fill of checked controls and person avatars.

tokens.name: mix-ink
tokens.usage: The neutral every hover, press and current mix takes in, so state grounds shift the surface underneath without leaving its family. ink by default; peach overrides it with a dark warm neutral from its own hue (#2e271d), so states blend into the warm ground instead of greying it.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill: checked checkboxes, person avatars, tooltips.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent, Infisical yellow #e3f047 in both themes. The fill of the one primary create action on a page (Add new, Create key, New connection), approval and grant buttons, counts (in the sidebar and the bulk action bar), the on switch track in dark, the slider range in dark and search highlights; the current page in the sidebar stays neutral. On light grounds the fill is nearly as light as the ground (1.09:1 on the sidebar, 1.20:1 on surface) and carries no edge: it is a highlight, and what it says is its on-accent text (16.7:1 on it), so the label, not the fill, identifies the control or the number. Never let a bare fill with no text carry meaning (a dot, a bar); use accent-fg for those. In dark it stands out on its own (16.7:1 on the sidebar, 15.1:1 on surface). A fill, never text on light grounds. For accent-colored text and icons (the banner), use accent-fg.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of accent buttons. A step darker than accent on the same hue; on-accent on it is 14.3:1 in light and 14.1:1 in dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill: near-black in both themes, because the fill does not change with theme (16.7:1 on accent; 14.3:1 on accent-2 in light, 14.1:1 in dark).

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Very light accent ground for a highlighted row, a callout and the production banner. Text on it is ink (19.5:1 light, 15.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Border of the production banner and other accent-wash callouts. A step darker than the wash (1.32:1 against it in light), like the status -line colors.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: The accent as text or an icon. Ink in light, where the accent cannot be read; the accent in dark (13.1:1 on toast-bg, 13.8:1 on accent-wash). The banner icon and link, and marks with no text in them, like the rail dot that stands for a count.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The mark's ink when UI draws it, such as the Spinner. Ink in light, the accent in dark, the same inks as the logo files.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success text, icons and dots. 7.7:1 on surface and 6.6:1 on ok-bg in light; 10.2:1 and 8.5:1 in dark. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: ok-deep
tokens.usage: Titles inside success alerts, on ok-wash (9.9:1 light, 12.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of success badges.

tokens.name: ok-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of success alerts.

tokens.name: ok-line
tokens.usage: Border of success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text, icons and near-limit progress. 6.6:1 on surface and 5.5:1 on warn-bg in light; 11.6:1 and 9.2:1 in dark.

tokens.name: warn-deep
tokens.usage: Titles inside warning alerts, on warn-wash.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of warning badges.

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of warning alerts.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Border of warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive buttons, over-limit progress. 5.8:1 on surface and 4.7:1 on bad-bg in light; 6.4:1 and 5.5:1 in dark. Told apart from ok by lightness and by its word or icon.

tokens.name: bad-deep
tokens.usage: Titles inside error alerts, on bad-wash.

tokens.name: bad-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of error badges and the icon tile in alert dialogs.

tokens.name: bad-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of error alerts; hover of danger ghost buttons.

tokens.name: bad-line
tokens.usage: Border of error badges and alerts.

tokens.name: bad-control
tokens.usage: Border of an invalid field at rest: bad at the control step (2.1:1 on surface in light, 2.0:1 in dark, like control), so an invalid field rests as quietly as any other. Focus or open turns it bad with the 3px bad nudge outline. The error text under it carries the message.

tokens.name: bad-fill
tokens.usage: Fill and border of the destructive Button. One red in both themes, so its on-bad label stays white (6.0:1); on the dark surface the fill is 3.1:1, enough for a control boundary. Text and icons in red still use bad, which lightens in dark.

tokens.name: on-bad
tokens.usage: Label on the destructive fill. White in both themes, because bad-fill does not change with theme: 6.0:1 on bad-fill and 8.0:1 on bad-hover.

tokens.name: bad-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of destructive buttons, the same in both themes so the white on-bad label holds (8.0:1).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons. 8.4:1 on surface, 6.9:1 on info-bg in light; 9.1:1 and 7.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: info-deep
tokens.usage: Titles inside info alerts, on info-wash.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of info badges.

tokens.name: info-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of info alerts.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Border of info badges and alerts.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, the first series of a categorical chart: --chart-1 and --color-chart-1. The chart series run chart-1 to chart-6 in order; take them from chartSeries rather than listing them.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2: --chart-2 and --color-chart-2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3: --chart-3 and --color-chart-3. On light grounds it is 1.20:1 on surface, below the 3:1 non-text floor, so a bar or segment in it needs a label or an edge to read.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4: --chart-4 and --color-chart-4.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5: --chart-5 and --color-chart-5.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6, a blue the other five lack: --chart-6 and --color-chart-6. 5.5:1 on surface in light; 6.7:1 on surface and 6.9:1 on inset in dark. Its nearest series is chart-2 at an OKLab distance of 0.19 in light and 0.17 in dark, wider than any pair among chart-1 to chart-5.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text of an inline link and the link Button: ink with a 1px underline at a 3px offset, as in the v4 reference. Hover moves to text2 with a 2px underline and never adds a background. Links are never blue; info is only for informational status.

tokens.name: sw-on
tokens.usage: Track and border of a switch that is on. Ink in light (20:1 on surface, where the lime fill would vanish at 1.2:1) and the accent in dark (15.1:1 on surface).

tokens.name: sw-knob-on
tokens.usage: Knob of a switch that is on: the accent on the ink track in light, on-accent ink on the accent track in dark.

tokens.name: slider-range
tokens.usage: Filled range of a slider: ink in light, the accent in dark. Ink keeps the filled part readable against the track in light.

tokens.name: slider-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track of a slider: faint in light so the track edge holds 3:1 on surface, line in dark.

tokens.name: toast-bg
tokens.usage: Toasts. Light on light, dark on dark: surface in light, a raised gray in dark (1.2:1 on the dark page). Always with toast-line and shadow-pop.

tokens.name: toast-line
tokens.usage: Border of toasts.

tokens.name: toast-text
tokens.usage: Titles and text in toasts (20.1:1 light, 14.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: toast-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and the dismiss icon in toasts (7.1:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: toast-ok
tokens.usage: Success icon in a toast (7.7:1 light, 8.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: toast-bad
tokens.usage: Error icon in a toast (5.8:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs, alert dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: button-face-start
tokens.usage: Light lime upper face of the primary Button beneath its colored inset illumination.

tokens.name: button-face-end
tokens.usage: Bright brand lime lower face of the primary Button.

tokens.name: button-bloom
tokens.usage: Lower interior light in the primary Button three-layer inset illumination.

tokens.name: button-hover-start
tokens.usage: Light lime upper face on hover, painted in the same border box.

tokens.name: button-hover-end
tokens.usage: Bright brand lime lower face on hover.

tokens.name: button-hover-bloom
tokens.usage: Two close lower interior lights in the primary Button five-layer hover illumination.

tokens.name: button-press-start
tokens.usage: Bright lime pressed primary Button face. Color feedback without movement.

tokens.name: button-press-end
tokens.usage: Bright lime pressed lower face without hover illumination.

tokens.name: button-glow
tokens.usage: The paired broad colored inset lights of the primary Button at rest.

tokens.name: button-hover-glow
tokens.usage: The paired wider colored inset lights of the primary Button on hover.

tokens.name: button-hover-bloom-soft
tokens.usage: The wider lower interior light behind the two close hover lights.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Explicit display headings and exceptional large figures. Ordinary interface titles use title-lg.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings, dialog and sheet titles.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Card titles and empty state titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Page ledes under the display title, in muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Syncs 14 secrets to GitHub Actions on every push.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Action labels and emphasized row titles. Field labels use field-label.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Help text, secondary lines and supporting descriptions.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, stage labels, dense metadata, in muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Explicit compact group labels only. Surface treatment does not change a heading into this role.

styles.name: field-label
styles.usage: Associated field labels. Required and optional hints remain part of the label.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Primary text in resource, member and activity rows. It does not inherit a page body size.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Secret keys, paths, hostnames, identity names, environment slugs.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Versions, dates in tables, shortcuts, counts, in muted.

spacing.note: The number is the pixel value. Layouts use the larger steps; controls use 6 to 16.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between icon buttons in a toolbar; title to description in stacked text; tile to tile inside a stepper.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Shell inset: between a tint shell and its content block (cards, tables, lists). Segmented track padding. Menu and listbox padding, so a row's hover ground sits 4px from the outer edge with the border. A field's end padding beside its nested items, so a slot sits 4px from the outer edge with the border.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap inside segmented tracks and pagination; between step segments; between grouped nested items in a field (reveal and copy, a shortcut and clear).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Label to control; badge dot to text; small button icon gap; combobox chip field padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons and inputs; buttons inside a row or item.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Small button padding; avatar to name; left and right padding inside text fields, input groups and select, combobox and multiselect triggers. Menu and listbox rows reach the same line: 3px list padding plus 7px row padding, so their text lines up with the trigger's.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Popover padding, both directions; gap between buttons in footers; dialog and sheet footer padding; gap between stacked blocks; alert grid gap.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Row padding in tables and item lists; default button padding; section heading to content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card, alert and alert dialog padding; gap between fields in a form.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet body padding; gap between checkbox options.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between side by side cards; combobox chip height; gap between header and nav.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between side by side sections.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Main panel padding; compact list row and tab height.

tokens.name: space-44
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Main panel bottom padding; the TopBar height (size-shell-bar). Table rows are size-row (40px), not this.

tokens.name: space-control-inline-sm
tokens.usage: Compact action inline inset. Also the inline padding of sm (32px) fields and the inset of their leading icon and chevron.

tokens.name: space-control-inline-md
tokens.usage: Inline padding of md (36px) fields. Field padding steps 10, 12, 14 with the 32, 36, 40 heights, and a leading icon sits at the same inset.

tokens.name: space-control-inline
tokens.usage: Ordinary and large action inline inset. Also the inline padding of lg (40px) fields.

tokens.name: space-control-gap
tokens.usage: Action icon and label gap.

tokens.name: space-field-label
tokens.usage: Field label to its control and supporting feedback.

tokens.name: space-field-group
tokens.usage: Between complete field groups.

tokens.name: space-content-group
tokens.usage: Related blocks inside a content section.

tokens.name: space-actions-gap
tokens.usage: Space between a text block and the action row under it: Item and List rows with actions below, Announcements, ApprovalQueue and Alert actions. Set as a gap (or the block padding of the action row in a tighter stack), never a margin on the buttons.

tokens.name: space-content-section
tokens.usage: Between independent open content sections.

tokens.name: space-shell-gap
tokens.usage: Gap on the right and bottom of the AppInset island (and on its top when there is no TopBar band, and its left when there is no sidebar), so the inset floats on the shell ground as a framed card.

tokens.name: space-crumb-divider
tokens.usage: Space on each side of a BandDivider, between the line and the ground of the target beside it: crumbs in either Breadcrumb variant and the TopBar's right cluster. The divider is an element in the layout flow, so both sides are always equal and no neighbor offsets it.

tokens.name: size-shell-bar
tokens.usage: Height of the TopBar band across the top of the AppShell, on the shell ground and outside the AppInset island. The island and the Sidebar both start below it.

tokens.name: space-sidebar-row-inset
tokens.usage: Inline padding of a Sidebar nav row, so its 18px glyph sits centered in the 36px rail row. The TopBar organization switcher uses it too, so its glyph and label line up with the rows below.

tokens.name: size-sidebar-icon
tokens.usage: Glyph of a Sidebar nav row and of the TopBar organization switcher above it.

tokens.name: size-shell-target
tokens.usage: Hover and press box height of every target in the TopBar band: crumb names, switcher chevrons, the organization switcher, the search and notification icon buttons and the account trigger. One height, centered in size-shell-bar, so no ground is taller or shorter than its neighbors. It equals the default Button height, so the band's Buttons use size sm.

tokens.name: size-shell-collapse
tokens.usage: AppShell width below which the Sidebar has no rail and opens only as a left Sheet from the TopBar menu button, the band keeps at most two crumbs, and the AppInset island drops its gaps and border to fill the shell. Measured on the shell itself, so an embedded shell collapses by its own width.

tokens.name: size-shell-rail
tokens.usage: AppShell width below which the Sidebar starts as the rail, and expanding it opens the full navigation as a left Sheet with a scrim instead of pushing the island. At this width and above the Sidebar starts expanded. Measured on the shell itself.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the expanded Sidebar. In the wide shell the TopBar's organization switcher fills it, so the divider after the switcher lines up with the island's left edge.

tokens.name: size-sidebar-rail
tokens.usage: Width of the collapsed Sidebar rail. Its 36px tools sit on the same 26px center line as the expanded corner toggle, so the toggle never moves.

tokens.name: size-unread
tokens.usage: The unread square on the notifications button, the announcements trigger and the narrow menu button, in accent-fg with a ring of the ground behind it.

tokens.name: size-touch-row
tokens.usage: Rows of the shell's bottom sheets (account and help below size-shell-collapse) and the nav Sheet's user row, sized for touch.

tokens.name: space-surface-inset
tokens.usage: Ordinary surface header, body and footer alignment edge.

tokens.name: space-surface-inset-sm
tokens.usage: Compact surface header, body and footer alignment edge.

tokens.name: space-overlay-inset
tokens.usage: Modal and sheet content alignment edge.

tokens.name: space-menu-inset
tokens.usage: Menu rows inset inside their containing border.

tokens.name: space-control-slot-inset
tokens.usage: Interior field inset. With the 1px border, a nested action sits 4px from the host outside edge.

tokens.name: space-control-slot-gap
tokens.usage: Between separate actions in one field slot.

tokens.name: space-row-inline
tokens.usage: Inline padding of every Table and DataTable cell: the 12px content edge that cell text and row indicator glyphs share. The sticky actions cell pads by space-row-actions-inset instead.

tokens.name: space-row-actions-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between row action targets and between row indicator slots. Neighbouring targets touch without overlapping, so 16px glyphs sit 12px apart.

tokens.name: space-row-actions-inset
tokens.usage: Inline padding on both sides of the sticky actions cell, inside its divider and the frame edge. With the 1px lines on either side it centers one size-target-row action in a size-row square, 5px clear of each line.

tokens.name: space-row-indent
tokens.usage: One depth step of a DataTable row's primary cell: rows under a group header and child rows from getRowChildren start this far inside the column's content edge. It equals an icon plus its 8px gap, so a child's text lines up with the label after its parent's icon.

tokens.name: size-action-bar
tokens.usage: Height of the FloatingActionBar. While the bar shows, AppInset adds this plus space-action-bar-offset as bottom padding, so the last row and the pagination can scroll clear of it.

tokens.name: space-action-bar-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between the FloatingActionBar and the bottom of the window.

size.note: Heights shared by controls and badges, so they line up in any row, and the slot that nested items take inside a field (size-nested-*: the field height minus 8px). The width floors live here too: size-cell-min for table columns, size-text-min for item and card text, size-tile-min for tile grids.

tokens.name: size-badge-sm
tokens.usage: Small badge height, inside table rows, item rows and sheet meta.

tokens.name: size-count
tokens.usage: Count chip height, in navigation and tabs.

tokens.name: size-badge
tokens.usage: Default badge height: identity, status and emphasis. Matches the count chip.

tokens.name: size-kbd-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd key cap on ink, inside tooltips. A single-glyph cap is exactly this square; longer labels keep the height and grow in width.

tokens.name: size-kbd-sm
tokens.usage: Small Kbd key cap, in menus, command rows, buttons and the TopBar search. A single-glyph cap is an 18px square; Ctrl, Shift and Esc keep the height and grow with equal side padding.

tokens.name: size-kbd-md
tokens.usage: Default Kbd key cap, in running text and field hints. A single-glyph cap is a 20px square; longer labels keep the height and grow with equal side padding.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small control height: small buttons and inputs, icon buttons in toolbars, menu items and options, segmented items, pagination pages.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Explicit comfortable md control height. Use size=md with iconOnly for a matching 36px standalone icon action. The ordinary default is 32px. Legacy icon aliases keep their explicit nested sizes.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Large control height: large buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: size-row-stacked
tokens.usage: Height of a row whose label stacks two lines (a small title over a caption subtitle, 34px of text), such as the option rows of a stacked picker. A 36px control row is too short for two lines.

tokens.name: size-nested-sm
tokens.usage: Slot for a nested item inside a small (32px) field: icon buttons, shortcut hints, clear buttons. 4px from the field's outer edge on every side.

tokens.name: size-nested-md
tokens.usage: Slot for a nested item inside an explicit comfortable md (36px) field: reveal, copy and clear icon buttons, a Kbd hint or a small Badge. The ordinary default uses nested-default at 24px. This explicit slot sits 4px from the field's outer edge; slots are 4px apart.

tokens.name: size-nested-lg
tokens.usage: Slot for a nested item inside a large (40px) field.

tokens.name: size-cell-min
tokens.usage: Floor for every Table and DataGrid column that fits its content. A column can set its own minWidth, or a fixed width.

tokens.name: size-text-min
tokens.usage: Floor for the main text of an item row and of a plain card heading. Buttons and badges beside it keep their width and drop under the text instead of squeezing it; the text truncates, with its full value on hover.

tokens.name: size-tile-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest a Tile gets in an ifs-tiles grid; below it the grid drops a column instead of squeezing tiles.

tokens.name: size-card-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest a Card gets in an auto-fit Grid (Grid min="card"); below it the grid drops to fewer columns, so DataList rows keep their label and value on one line.

tokens.name: size-tooltip-max
tokens.usage: Widest a Tooltip grows; longer text wraps inside it instead of overflowing. Tooltip content always resets white-space, so a trigger inside a nowrap cell never forces one long line.

tokens.name: size-menu-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest a menu, listbox or command list panel gets. A panel is never narrower than its trigger either, and grows with its widest row up to size-menu-max.

tokens.name: size-menu-max
tokens.usage: Widest a menu or listbox panel grows from its content. A trigger wider than this still sets the panel's minimum; rows past it truncate their label instead of wrapping.

tokens.name: size-popover
tokens.usage: Width of a popover and a hover card, both padded space-12.

tokens.name: size-toast
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a toast. A ToastStack is as wide as its widest title or description up to this width, so a short notice stays compact and a long title wraps to two lines instead of a tall, narrow card; actions never widen it. The Sonner Toaster draws every toast at this width.

tokens.name: size-dialog
tokens.usage: Maximum width of an ordinary dialog and alert dialog.

tokens.name: size-dialog-wide
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the command palette dialog: a search row and result rows with room for descriptions and shortcuts.

tokens.name: size-sheet-sm
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a side sheet at size sm, the default: a details panel or a short form with one column of fields.

tokens.name: size-sheet-md
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a side sheet at size md: a create form with a key, a multiline value and a few options, like Create secret and Add machine identity.

tokens.name: size-sheet-lg
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a side sheet at size lg: a form sheet with field pairs, credentials or a step bar, like New connection and an auth method. On a viewport narrower than this the sheet is capped at the viewport width.

tokens.name: size-overlay-margin
tokens.usage: Space a centered dialog or alert dialog keeps from each viewport edge; its height caps at the viewport minus twice this.

tokens.name: size-control-xs
tokens.usage: Explicit 24px nested action and shortcut slot; not the ordinary form action.

tokens.name: size-control-border
tokens.usage: Structural border included in every filled and outlined control box.

tokens.name: size-crumb-divider
tokens.usage: Height of the vertical breadcrumb divider: one icon height, so it spans the text and the switcher chevron without reaching the edges of the 48px TopBar.

tokens.name: size-crumb-divider-width
tokens.usage: Stroke of the vertical breadcrumb divider, one structural line.

tokens.name: size-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Width of every keyboard focus mark. A focused field draws an ink border plus this much focus-ring outside it; buttons, tabs and other actions draw an ink outline this wide, offset by the same amount.

tokens.name: size-focus-glow
tokens.usage: Width of the soft focus glow (focus-ring color) outside a focused field, slider thumb or other control that shows focus as a glow rather than an outline. One token for every glow so fields and sliders match.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Compact action icons next to readable 14px labels.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Ordinary action icons and standalone interface marks.

tokens.name: size-icon-xs
tokens.usage: Explicit 24px nested action icons.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons inside a small empty-state tile and bare empty-state marks at sm size.

tokens.name: size-icon-xl
tokens.usage: Icons inside a default empty-state tile and bare empty-state marks.

tokens.name: size-empty-media
tokens.usage: The tinted media tile above a default empty-state title, twice its icon.

tokens.name: size-empty-media-sm
tokens.usage: The tinted media tile in an sm empty state, inside lists, menus and table bodies.

tokens.name: size-content
tokens.usage: The one page content width. AppInset derives its page gutter from it, and TopBar and PageGutter both pad by that gutter, so the breadcrumb, the page header and the page body share one width and one left edge in the workbench, its docs pages and every composition. Never cap page content with an arbitrary max-width.

tokens.name: size-measure-page
tokens.usage: Maximum outer content measure for layout primitives (Container, MeasurePage). Equal to size-content so a primitive and the page gutter agree.

tokens.name: size-measure-form
tokens.usage: Maximum form and workbench article measure.

tokens.name: size-measure-field
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a stacked form field and its control, so a name, ID or select keeps a bounded width inside wide cards. Search inputs and table toolbars are not Fields and stay full width.

tokens.name: size-measure-field-wide
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a wide Field: it fills its column. For multi-column form rows (host and port, name and TTLs) in dynamic secret, secret rotation and app connection forms, where the row's grid sets each field's width and the stacked field measure would leave gaps.

tokens.name: size-measure-prose
tokens.usage: Readable prose line measure.

tokens.name: size-sidecar
tokens.usage: Width of the DetailLayout sidecar: the details card (a props DataList) beside a detail page's stacked content cards. The current product draws this card at 24rem. It is the narrowest width at which an ID row keeps a full UUID on one line (360px wraps it); at size-content it leaves the main column 752px.

tokens.name: size-sidecar-collapse
tokens.usage: DetailLayout width below which the sidecar stops sitting beside the main column and stacks above it. Measured on the layout itself with a container query, the same 56rem container breakpoint the current product's detail pages use. At this width the main column keeps 488px.

tokens.name: size-data-list-term
tokens.usage: Term column of a compact DataList full-width row. A term wider than this wraps between words, and a single word longer than it widens the column instead of breaking. Fits Signature algorithm and Certificate authority on one line in body type.

tokens.name: size-data-list-row
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a compact DataList row, the same 32px as a small control, so a Badge or small button in the value does not grow the row. Default DataList rows keep their 8px padding and 12px gap.

tokens.name: size-control-default
tokens.usage: Ordinary 32px action and field height. Explicit md remains 36px and lg remains 40px.

tokens.name: size-nested-default
tokens.usage: Ordinary 24px nested action inside a default 32px field. Explicit md36 fields use nested-md28.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Table and DataTable body row height. DataTable reads it at runtime as its default virtual row metric, so the CSS row and the scroll model share one number.

tokens.name: size-target-row
tokens.usage: Hit target of an icon-only row action (Button size icon-row) and the slot of a standalone row indicator. In a size-row row its 2px focus outline at a 2px offset draws a 36px box that stays 2px inside the row. Row indicators pull into the cell padding by (size-target-row - size-glyph) / 2, so the glyph, not the target, lands on the space-row-inline content edge.

tokens.name: size-row-action-step
tokens.usage: Width each action adds to the sticky actions column after its first. The column is size-row wide for one action (a square cell) and size-row plus this step for every further action, so its width follows its contents.

tokens.name: size-glyph
tokens.usage: Glyph of a row action and of a standalone row indicator such as a reminder, metadata or replication mark. One size everywhere, so a mark in a value cell and the matching action in the actions column read as the same glyph. Field and nested actions keep size-icon-xs and size-icon-sm.

tokens.name: size-glyph-sm
tokens.usage: Small supporting glyph, 14px: the glyph in a default (20px) Badge, before or after its label.

tokens.name: size-badge-glyph
tokens.usage: Glyph inside a default (size-badge, 20px) Badge: 14px, which leaves a 3px inset above and below inside the border.

tokens.name: size-badge-glyph-sm
tokens.usage: Glyph inside a small (size-badge-sm, 16px) Badge: 12px, so the glyph never fills the whole height inside the border.

tokens.name: size-scroll-fade
tokens.usage: Depth of the edge fade on a scroll area that has more content past that edge. Half a 32px row, so the last visible row stays readable while the fade still signals more; v3 used 2rem against taller rows.

tokens.name: size-skeleton-text
tokens.usage: Default Skeleton height: a placeholder for one line of text, in skeleton lines and DataTable loading rows. Shorter than the 20px line so stacked placeholders keep their gaps.

shape.note: Square corners are the only shape: no surface, control or portal sets a border radius, so there is no radius scale and no corner mode. The remaining shape token is the icon stroke.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Optical stroke for the canonical interface icon set, scaled by its SVG viewBox.

shadow.note: Depth shadows describe surface elevation. Inset surfaces get a 1px lift, overlays get a real shadow, and other surfaces stay flat. Focus, selection, errors and pressed states use outlines, borders and color. The canonical primary Button is the only exception for colored inset face and hover illumination. All of its light stays inside the control; it has no external or drop shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Inset surfaces inside a tint frame: cards, tables, lists.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, listboxes, popovers, dialogs, sheets, toasts.

opacity.note: Opacity steps. row-dim fades the other rows of a table body while one row is being edited. nudge is the focus ring: a focused field draws a size-focus-ring ring of ink at this opacity outside a 1px ink border, and a focused invalid field draws the same ring in bad outside a bad border. Fields at rest have no ring, invalid ones included.

tokens.name: opacity-row-dim
tokens.usage: Cell contents of the other rows in a table body while a row is focused for editing (TableRow focused, DataTable focusedRowId), applied as filter: opacity so it composes with opacity reveals inside the cells. Row grounds, borders, headers and portalled popovers stay at full strength.

tokens.name: opacity-nudge
tokens.usage: Focus ring opacity in light: 2px of ink at 15% outside the ink border, and 2px of bad at 15% on a focused invalid field. The 1px border carries the contrast.

tokens.name: opacity-nudge-dark
tokens.usage: Focus ring opacity in dark. Higher than light because bone at 15% on the near-black surface is barely distinguishable from it; 28% keeps the ring visible.

motion.note: Three durations by the size of what moves, each with a quicker exit, and springs for things that move. Enter on the tier, leave on the exit tier. Reduced motion snaps travel and scale and keeps fades.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press color changes, menus, popovers, selects and tooltips opening, and the check and radio marks drawing.

tokens.name: duration-moderate
tokens.usage: Indicators sliding between items, the switch thumb, disclosures expanding, the sidebar changing width, the Button glow and chevrons turning.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Large surfaces entering, such as dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: duration-exit-fast
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, selects and tooltips closing, and marks retracting.

tokens.name: duration-exit-moderate
tokens.usage: Disclosures collapsing and indicators fading out.

tokens.name: duration-exit-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets and their scrim leaving.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Moves and resizes that are not springs, such as the sidebar width.

tokens.name: ease-fade
tokens.usage: Opacity and color fades that do not move anything.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Enters and moves on the fast and moderate tiers. Critically damped, so it never overshoots.

tokens.name: ease-spring-soft
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets entering on the slow tier. Overshoots by under half a percent.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Everything leaving, so a dismissal reads as final.

tokens.name: ease-press
tokens.usage: A pressed button releasing back to rest.

appearance.note: Component paint roles follow the resolved scope theme, including stateful controls and overlays.

tokens.name: hover-mix
tokens.usage: How much mix-ink the shared hover overlay takes: 4% in light schemes, where it darkens the ground, and 8% in dark schemes, where ink is near white and it brightens the ground. The one place to tune hover strength.

tokens.name: press-mix
tokens.usage: How much ink the shared press overlay takes while a pointer is down: one step past hover-mix in each scheme.

tokens.name: current-mix
tokens.usage: How much mix-ink sidebar-current mixes into the sidebar: a small step past hover-mix (4% light, 8% dark). The current row also takes bold text, so the color step stays quiet.

tokens.name: selected-mix
tokens.usage: Alpha of the selected-surface fill: 30% in light and 33% in dark, a step past the hover overlay in every theme.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: The one hover ground for every neutral interactive surface: sidebar rows and tools, table, list, tree and grid rows, menu and listbox rows, segments, ghost and outline actions. Translucent ink, so it lands on whatever ground is underneath and shifts it darker in light and brighter in dark with no per-theme value. Where an opaque fill is needed (a pinned cell, a ring that cuts out a dot), mix ink at hover-mix into that ground in srgb, which matches how the overlay composites: color-mix(in srgb, var(--v4-ink) var(--v4-hover-mix), var(--v4-sidebar)).

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: The pressed ground of the same surfaces as hover, while a pointer is down.

tokens.name: control-surface
tokens.usage: Theme-specific control surface paint.

tokens.name: control-surface-hover
tokens.usage: Theme-specific control surface hover paint.

tokens.name: control-disabled-surface
tokens.usage: Theme-specific control disabled surface paint.

tokens.name: control-invalid-border
tokens.usage: Border of an invalid field, at rest and on focus. Invalid fields have no ring until they are focused.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The shared soft focus glow, drawn size-focus-glow wide outside a focused field, an open field and a focused or hovered slider thumb. Ink at opacity-nudge: a neutral gray that reads as a shadow in light, never the accent.

tokens.name: focus-ring-bad
tokens.usage: The focus ring of a focused invalid field, and of destructive actions. Same width and opacity as focus-ring.

tokens.name: action-danger-surface
tokens.usage: Theme-specific action danger surface paint.

tokens.name: action-danger-hover
tokens.usage: Theme-specific action danger hover paint.

tokens.name: action-ghost-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground of ghost buttons and other ghost-styled actions: the shared hover overlay.

tokens.name: action-outline-border
tokens.usage: Theme-specific action outline border paint.

tokens.name: action-outline-surface
tokens.usage: Theme-specific action outline surface paint.

tokens.name: action-outline-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground of outline buttons, triggers and toggles: the shared hover overlay over their own surface.

tokens.name: choice-selected-surface
tokens.usage: Theme-specific choice selected surface paint.

tokens.name: choice-selected-border
tokens.usage: Theme-specific choice selected border paint.

tokens.name: switch-off-surface
tokens.usage: Track of a switch that is off: the surface, outlined in muted (7:1 light, 9:1 dark), so off reads as an available control, not a disabled one.

tokens.name: switch-thumb
tokens.usage: Knob of a switch that is off: muted, the same ink as the outline.

tokens.name: switch-thumb-line
tokens.usage: Hairline around the off knob in light, so a white knob stays visible on the light grey track.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb
tokens.usage: Resting scrollbar thumb on every v4 scroller and ScrollArea. Mixed from ink so it stays quiet in both themes.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb-hover
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb while the pointer is over its scroller.

tokens.name: avatar-blend
tokens.usage: Theme-specific avatar blend paint.

tokens.name: tab-label
tokens.usage: Theme-specific tab label paint.

tokens.name: selected-surface
tokens.usage: Fill of a pressed or current control: a pressed Toggle, the current page, a selected list or table row and a selected Button. A translucent neutral step toward the surface it sits on, so whatever sits behind it stays visible. Light is a warm gray at L 0.915 on surface; dark is a neutral gray at L 0.32 at selected-mix, a step past hover, a quiet step above tint with no yellow cast, matching light's behavior. The sliding thumb of segmented tabs and of a ToggleGroup is pop in light and surface with a line border in dark, a cut-in thumb rather than this fill. Paired rule: an on item has ink text and this fill and border; an off item has muted text. A disabled on item keeps the fill and border and only dims its text.

tokens.name: selected-border
tokens.usage: Border of a pressed or current control. One step stronger than the outline border; neutral gray in dark, like selected-surface.

tokens.name: selected-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a pressed or current control.
